stories.title: Elecciones de medio mandato en Estados Unidos: siete batallas que definirán el futuro post-Trump

en.title: United States midterm elections: seven battles that will define the post-Trump future
en.summary: With one month until the election, control of the Senate remains uncertain as a handful of seats will determine the outcome.

stories.title: Norman Foster añade una tercera piel al Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao

en.title: Norman Foster adds a third skin to the Museum of Fine Arts in Bilbao
en.summary: Architect Norman Foster has designed an expansion for Bilbao's Museum of Fine Arts, part of a broader trend of growing museum projects by renowned architects worldwide.

stories.title: Muere una mujer de 102 años y rescatan a 90 en la riada de Madrigueras (Albacete)

en.title: A 102-year-old woman dies and 90 people are rescued in flooding in Madrigueras (Albacete)
en.summary: Heavy rainfall of 142 liters per square meter struck the Albacete municipality, triggering emergency response protocols and resulting in one death and multiple rescues.

stories.title: ¿Lastre o cartucho final? A Trump le queda un mes para la remontada en las elecciones de medio mandato

en.title: Burden or final card? Trump has one month left for a comeback in the midterm elections
en.summary: Trump faces difficult odds in the midterm elections scheduled for November 3, with polls showing an uphill campaign and risk of losing at least one chamber of Congress, challenging the traditional pattern where the sitting president's party loses seats.

stories.title: Hallada muerta una mujer de 102 años tras las inundaciones en Madrigueras (Albacete)

en.title: A 102-year-old woman found dead after floods in Madrigueras (Albacete)
en.summary: A woman aged 102 died in flooding in Madrigueras, where approximately 90 people required rescue from water-affected homes.

stories.title: Feijóo no se cree todavía que Sánchez adelante las elecciones pero apunta al "incentivo" de "evitar el calvario judicial"

en.title: Feijóo does not yet believe that Sánchez will call early elections but points to the "incentive" of "avoiding judicial ordeal"
en.summary: The opposition People's Party suggests the government may advance elections as an incentive to avoid judicial proceedings, noting the government has previously faced pressure to hold elections without following through.

stories.title: Una riada en Albacete se cobra la vida de una mujer de 102 años

en.title: A flood in Albacete claims the life of a 102-year-old woman
en.summary: Flooding in Madrigueras resulted in the death of a 102-year-old woman and necessitated the rescue of 90 other people from inundated areas.

stories.title: Bilbao estrena un Museo de Bellas Artes a otra escala: "Norman Foster ha creado una de las más bonitas salas de exposiciones"

en.title: Bilbao unveils a Fine Arts Museum at another scale: "Norman Foster has created one of the most beautiful exhibition halls"
en.summary: Bilbao's Fine Arts Museum reopened following an architectural renovation by Norman Foster, offering expanded exhibition space, increased representation of female artists, and updated curatorial approaches.

stories.title: Christa Pike, inconsciente y conectada a un respirador tras su ejecución fallida

en.title: Christa Pike, unconscious and connected to a ventilator after her failed execution
en.summary: Christa Pike was hospitalized following a failed execution, arriving with burns and blisters on her arms, according to her legal representatives.

stories.title: Feijóo exige elecciones a Sánchez tras el rechazo a los decretos: “La escapada debe terminar aquí”

en.title: Feijóo demands elections from Sánchez after rejection of decrees: "The escape must end here"
en.summary: The PP leader challenged the government president to call elections following the parliament's rejection of government decrees.

stories.title: Rajoy y González coinciden en pedir elecciones a Sánchez y un “pacto de Estado” sobre vivienda

en.title: Rajoy and González agree on calling elections to Sánchez and a "State Pact" on housing
en.summary: Two former Spanish presidents called for elections and proposed inter-party agreements on housing policy and the Ceuta crisis.

stories.title: Five Guys acelera sus aperturas en España con ocho locales al año

en.title: Five Guys accelerates its openings in Spain with eight locations per year
en.summary: Five Guys plans to reach 50 stores in Spain by 2027, with double-digit growth expected this year.

stories.title: ¿Quién manda en los escúteres de rueda alta?

en.title: Who dominates the large-wheel scooter market?
en.summary: Large-wheel scooters became prevalent in Spain starting with Honda Scoopy's 16-inch wheel design, offering better stability on urban terrain before the market shifted toward smaller 13 and 14-inch wheel models.

stories.title: La Caixa blinda su poder en el consejo de Naturgy

en.title: La Caixa strengthens its power on Naturgy's board
en.summary: Naturgy announced key changes to its board voting system through official regulatory filings.

stories.title: Iberdrola y Telefónica, contra el decreto de centros de datos

en.title: Iberdrola and Telefónica oppose the data centers decree
en.summary: Iberdrola's CEO in Spain argued against demonizing data centers, opposing a government decree affecting their development.

stories.title: Repsol y Santander baten beneficios y lideran el récord de cotizadas

en.title: Repsol and Santander beat profits and lead record for listed companies
en.summary: Spanish listed companies achieved record profits, with banking, energy, and concessions sectors driving a 15.5% increase in overall earnings and a 6.6% rise in revenue.
